## Changelog

What players will read in the launcher and on the website. Each entry under a type heading
(`### Added`, `### Changed`, `### Deprecated`, `### Removed`, `### Fixed`, `### Security`) and
starting with its area (`[vehicles]`, `[ui]`…, list in
[components.json](https://github.com/DyingStar-game/changelog/blob/main/components.json)).
Rules: [ADR 0001](https://github.com/DyingStar-game/changelog/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-changelog-format.md).
No player-visible change: delete both blocks.
